text:
anita: FYI staging smoke tests failed on image verify + vuln scanner flagged libc. Need quick coord: RBAC for signer, KMS access check, audit logs. Not blocking prod yet. :warning:
kevin: paste the scanner snippet?
anita: `glibc CVE-20YY-0ZZZ -> upgrade suggested to 2.34. runtime: cosign verify failing: 'no matching signature'`
jordan: paging sec oncall. is this rollout-related?
maria: eyeballing last night's RBAC PR #4210 that tightened service account scopes. could be that. I'll check KMS bindings against the key used by signer.
kevin: who is the signer principal currently? I have `svc-image-signer@redwood` and `svc-cip-runner@redwood` in memory.
jordan: PR 4210 removed cross-project IAM for a few service accounts. That might have orphaned the signer on the shared key.
ops-oncall: deploy-bot: canary failed: image verification error at startup. See /var/log/containers/image-verify.log
deploy-bot: log excerpt: `cosign: error: failed to fetch public key: permission denied`
anita: Triage plan: 1) confirm KMS key IAM membership for svc-image-signer, 2) run cosign verify with debug and attach logs, 3) if missing binding, add targeted binding with audit justification + 24h expiry, 4) if that fails, apply a staging-only admission exception for that digest. Who owns step 1/2?
maria: I'll take step 1 (KMS IAM check). ETA 12m.
kevin: I'll run cosign verify against the failing digest and paste debug. Command I will run:
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 COSIGN_OIDC_CLIENT_ID=redwood-cosign cosign verify --key k8s://gcp-kms/projects/blue/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/signer-key --debug gcr.io/redwood/base@sha256:deadbeef1234
```
kevin: also will run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/signer-key --project=blue`
maria: update: svc-image-signer is present in IAM but scoped to `projects/locked-builds`. The build pipeline is using `projects/broad-builds` key path. mismatch.
jordan: quick options: A) add svc-image-signer to the broad-builds key IAM (smallest change) B) force the signer to point to locked-builds key (deploy/config change) C) use temporary admission exception (higher risk)
ops-oncall: We can apply option A quickly. Will require sec approval and we'll annotate the IAM change with a justification and TTL in the audit logs.
anita: I approve a targeted IAM add with explicit justification. Keep it minimal and expire in 24h. Log the exact gcloud command in the incident ticket INC-2119.
maria: performing IAM add now: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/broad-builds/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/signer-key --member=serviceAccount:svc-image-signer@redwood --role=roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier --project=broad-builds`
maria: done. I've added an audit annotation: "INC-2119: temporary binding while we reconcile RBAC mapping".
kevin: re-running cosign verify...
kevin: verify success: `Signature verified for sha256:deadbeef1234`
deploy-bot: canary requeued.
ops-oncall: applied canary requeue; watching logs.
deploy-bot: canary: PASS (image verify + smoke tests)
anita: nice. Post-issue action items: 1) postmortem: why PR 4210 removed cross-project binding without a map, 2) add an automated CI check that warns when a RBAC change touches signer principals and there's a KMS key referenced in another project, 3) add image annotation at build time with `kms-key: projects/.../cryptoKeys/...` so mapping is explicit.
jordan: I'll pick up the postmortem write and the PR that adds the CI guard.
kevin: I'll do the buildkite step to annotate images with kms-key at buildtime. PR incoming.
maria: I'll audit other keys for similar mismatches and open follow-up tickets.
anita: I'll open INC-2119, collect Cloud Audit logs (KMS AsymmetricSign calls and IAM PolicyChange), GCR access logs, and link to the postmortem draft. Closing when postmortem draft and fix PRs are in. :v:
